caseNameFull: Fred P. Violette v. Charles A. Rasmusson, Collector of Internal Revenue, etc.
attorneys: Mr. Joseph W. Cox and Mr. Charles A. Russell for appellant. Mr. Chas. N. Madeen, Mr. H. H. Clarke, and Mr. Dan J. Heyjron were also on the brief. Mr. Solicitor General Beck and Mrs. Mabel Walker Willebrandt, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Decree reversed with costs; and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the District of Montana for further proceedings. Lipke v. Lederer, 259 U. S. 557.
